purpose: Expose canonical FrictionMemory through the normal Song learning journey so the artist can explicitly record a blocker against a real Learning episode, inspect Song-scoped friction history, and see recurring blockers only when the same explicit key is evidenced across multiple distinct work Sessions.

lineage.outcome: The artist can preserve what repeatedly gets in the way of real Song work and distinguish one incident from a genuinely recurring blocker, with only artist-recorded prevention ideas presented as such.
lineage.capability: Consumer-reachable Friction Memory with distinct-Session recurrence

why_now: REQ-SCOPE-138 is a required pre-Gate-B minimum. CORE-02D already owns append-only explicit Friction observations and recurrence synthesis, while SONG-LEARNING-01 now creates real consumer Learning episodes. The missing high-leverage seam is consumer capture and truthful recurrence reachability, not another process-memory store.
completion_proof: the normal Song learning surface shows explicit Friction observations without exposing internal Friction, Learning, Session or source-reference identities
artist Friction capture binds one exact active Song and one exact canonical Learning episode behind opaque one-shot browser authority
consumer-created Friction evidence is USER_DECLARED only and receives a server-owned source reference
blocker key, description, confidence and optional prevention hint are bounded human inputs; the consumer path cannot manufacture observed/measured/provider evidence
one incident remains an incident and is never labeled recurring
recurrence appears only when the same explicit friction key exists across at least two distinct work Sessions
multiple episodes in one Session cannot manufacture recurrence
prevention ideas are displayed only when actually recorded and are not presented as N0TE-generated rules
GET is pure and Song-scoped; capture does not mutate Versions, approvals, Session state, Learning decisions, Skill state, Focus, DAWs or providers
Origin, CSRF, one-shot replay, active-Song staleness, profile isolation and quit/relaunch persistence remain enforced
authored core/HTTP/restart proof remains separate from executed evidence
next_selection_rule: After landing or blockage, globally reselect across interaction/teaching modes, Context/History reachability, References, Compare/A-B, Creative Studio, audio-analysis substrate, DAW/OPS and all other Gate-B blockers.
